explanation.text:
Your product is likely to meet the AfCFTA rules of origin.

Main reasons:
- One imported ingredient is in heading 19.01: Bakery premix preparation, value GHS 5,960.00. This is 14.9% of the ex-works price of GHS 40,000.00. The limit is 15%.
- These manufacturing processes are eligible under AfCFTA guidelines: mashing of malt with hot water in a mash tun (enzymatic conversion) and drum drying of the malt extract with part of the flour.

Note: the 15% limit is the AfCFTA tolerance rule. Your margin is 0.1 percentage points. A change in prices or recipe can change the result.

What to do next:
- Keep your supplier declarations, invoices and production records together.
- You decide whether to apply. GRA Customs and the National AfCFTA Approval Committee make the official decision.
